item.title: Overgrown weeds around the drain appear to be attracting drain flies, which are entering the property through the kitchen window., 23rd September
item.description:
I would like to request that the overgrown weeds and vegetation in the area outside the property are cleared. The vegetation has become heavily overgrown and appears to be contributing to the ongoing pest issue in the area. In particular, we have been experiencing a significant problem with drain flies, and the damp, overgrown conditions around the drains and weeds seem to be providing a suitable environment for them to breed and gather. The drain is located directly outside the kitchen window, and the flies are subsequently entering the property and causing an infestation inside the flat. I would therefore appreciate it if the council could arrange for the overgrown weeds and vegetation to be cleared, as well as assess whether the surrounding drainage needs attention. This has become an ongoing issue and is affecting the living conditions inside the property. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 126, Peckham Hill Street, Peckham, Greater London
